blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
In business English, time lives in one small word: at. Meetings, calls and breaks all live on a clock. We say at 9 am, at noon, at 3:30.

At Czarnikow, the day has a schedule. People start at 9 am and finish at 6 pm. There is a break at noon. Many meetings are at 10, and some calls are at 3:30.

Times are short and clear. "The meeting is at 10." "See you at 5." "Coffee at 10:30." When you know the word at, you can talk about any hour, minute or meeting.

items.q: What time do people start at Czarnikow?
items.why: "People start at 9 am and finish at 6 pm."

items.q: When is the break?
items.why: "There is a break at noon." Noon = meio-dia.

items.q: Which small word does the text say time "lives" in?
items.why: "In business English, time lives in one small word: at."

items.q: The text suggests that, once you know "at", you can…
options: talk about any hour, minute or meeting
items.why: Inferência: "When you know the word at, you can talk about any hour, minute or meeting."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: business times are long and hard to say
business times are short and clear
you do not need the word at
meetings never have a fixed time
items.why: Inferência: "Times are short and clear" — o texto todo mostra frases curtas com at.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver falar sobre a agenda do dia. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I am Oliver. Let me tell you about my day at Czarnikow. It is simple, but listen: every time uses the same small word. That word is at.

I start work at 9 am. I open my computer and I look at my schedule. My first meeting is at 10. It is a short meeting, about thirty minutes. We talk about our week. Then I have a call at 11:30 with a client. The client is in London, so the time is important.

My break is at noon. I like my break. I get a coffee and I rest for one hour. After lunch, I have another meeting at 2. We look at the schedule again and we plan the next days.

At 3:30 there is a team call. It is quick, only fifteen minutes. Then I finish my emails. I stop work at 6 pm. Before I go home, I say to my team: "See you tomorrow at 9."

So, that is my day. Nine, ten, half past eleven, noon, two, three thirty, six. Every meeting, every break, every call — they all start at a time. Now, can you say your day with at? Try it. Take your time!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time is Oliver's first meeting?
items.why: "My first meeting is at 10."

items.q: What time does Oliver stop work?
items.why: "I stop work at 6 pm."

items.q: What does Oliver do on his break?
options: He gets a coffee and rests
items.why: "I get a coffee and I rest for one hour."

items.q: Oliver says "See you tomorrow at 9." This suggests that…
options: he starts every day at the same time
items.why: Inferência: ele começa às 9 am, então "at 9" amanhã é o mesmo início de sempre.

items.q: How would you best describe Oliver's day?
items.why: Inferência: ele mesmo diz "It is simple" e lista horários claros com at.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The meeting is one hour long." An hour is…
items.why: Hour = hora (60 minutos).

items.q: "The call is only ten minutes." A minute is…
options: a short part of an hour
items.why: Minute = minuto: uma parte curta da hora.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have a ___ at 10 with the whole team."
items.why: Meeting = reunião — é o encontro do time às 10.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Let me check my ___ for tomorrow's times."
items.why: Schedule = agenda: onde ficam os horários do dia.

items.q: "I take a short break at noon." A break is…
items.why: Break = pausa: um tempo para descansar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem quando falamos de horários e reuniões. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting for 10." To set up a meeting means to…
items.why: Set up = marcar/organizar a reunião.

items.q: "Can we move the meeting to 3?" To move a meeting means to…
items.why: Move the meeting = mudar o horário dela.

items.q: "See you at 5. Don't be late." This means…
items.why: Don't be late = não atrase, chegue no horário.

items.q: "The meeting is on time." On time means…
items.why: On time = na hora certa.

items.q: "Let's take a break at noon." To take a break means to…
items.why: Take a break = fazer uma pausa, parar para descansar.
